parsed.main_gap: Lemma 2 — the weight-descent producing a bounded minimal support containing each prime — is asserted with 'details omitted'. It is the crux where arithmetic (the size a_1 and coprime witnesses) enters; without it the argument is only combinatorial.

errors.description: The pivotal Lemma 2 is left unproved. Its proof is the only place where actual integer sizes and the 'smaller coprime witness' property yield finiteness; declaring it 'standard' gives no argument that the descent terminates or that the witness support contains p and misses C\{p}. Everything downstream (terminality, boundedness of |D|, finiteness of C) rests on it.
errors.quote: **Proof.** This follows by a descent on the weight $w$ (standard; details omitted). $\square$

errors.description: In the sunflower argument the petals C_i \ R are used as nonempty (an infinite family of pairwise disjoint nonempty petals). The possibility C_i = R (empty petal) is not addressed, though it is easily excluded by the antichain property. Minor.
errors.quote: The petals $C_i\setminus R$ are pairwise disjoint.

parsed.notes: Framework is sound and correct: support-invariance of acceptance, self-duality (1), reduction to minimal supports (2), and the sunflower proof of Lemma 1 are all properly argued, as is the final periodicity deduction. Only the key arithmetic descent is missing.
